title: Late-Change Fee Terms for the Riverbend Self-Pay Outpatient Surgery Package
content:
**Term 1 — Scope.** For a late patient move of a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates, this term settles the late-change fee kept from the deposits, and only for such a move. A cancellation that ends a package booking keeps the type's late-cancellation fee from the deposits when made later than the full-refund days, never more than the deposits held, unless the cancelling physician documents a medical reason, the remainder being refunded; and a move made at least the full-refund days before the slot date, or one Riverbend initiated, carries no fee.

**Term 2 — Late patient move.** A late patient move of a surgery booking is a cancellation of its procedure slot, the first patient-cancelled Outpatient Procedure Appointment the appointment record lists, made on or before the slot date and fewer calendar days before it than the type's full-refund days, while the estimate is not cancelled and its current version, a later version furnished on or after the cancellation date, carries a scheduled service date different from the slot date, with no Riverbend inpatient room charge (revenue code 0120) or observation charge (revenue code 0762) dated on the cancellation date. Such a charge counts only when the hospital account it is posted on — for each of the two codes, the account of the first such line the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account activity lists for that date — carries charges net of the charge credits recorded on that account above zero, so that a credited line on an account that still carries net charges still counts. Here the patient's procedure slot is the patient's Outpatient Procedure Appointment in Appointment Scheduling that shows cancelled by the patient: its cancellation date is the change date and its scheduled date is the original slot date; where the patient has cancelled more than one such slot, the first one the appointment record lists is the one read.

**Term 3 — No fee.** A move made while the patient's Riverbend hospital accounts carry an inpatient room charge (revenue code 0120) or an observation charge (revenue code 0762) with a service date equal to the change date, read as Term 2 reads it, is a medically documented change, not a late patient move, and carries no fee. A booking whose patient's award covers the new scheduled service date and either is at the Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) tier, or carries a hardship liability cap with no cap left, carries no late-change fee. A booking carries at most one late-change fee: once a retained late-change fee entry stands on the booking, no further fee is kept. For this term the patient's award is the patient's approved case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the new scheduled service date when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

**Term 4 — Deposits held.** The deposits held on a moved surgical package booking are its deposit collections less every refund, retained fee and application already drawn on them. The fee is kept once, from the most recent deposit collection on the booking that can cover it.

**Term 5 — The fee.** The fee basis of a late surgical move is the late-cancellation fee of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery type in the package deposit and cancellation schedule, and the late-change fee on a moved surgical package booking is that fee basis, kept from the deposits held on the booking and never more than those deposits. The fee is figured in one pass on the fee basis: each share of the fee basis kept for the move multiplies it, the product is rounded half-up to the cent once (an exact half cent going up), and the fee kept is never more than the deposits held.

## Testing a move (hypothetical; a type with 7 full-refund days, slot on day S)

| Patient cancelled the slot on | Later version furnished | New date differs | Room or observation charge that day | Late patient move? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S minus 3 | on S minus 3 | yes | none | yes |
| S minus 7 | on S minus 7 | yes | none | no — not fewer than 7 days before |
| S plus 1 | after | yes | none | no — after the slot date |
| S minus 3 | only before S minus 3 | yes | none | no — no later version on or after the cancellation |
| S minus 3 | on S minus 2 | yes | observation charge on an account with net charges above zero | no — medically documented change |

## Worked figure (illustration only)

Taking a fee basis of 200.00 with no share applying: deposits held of 3000.00 give a fee kept of 200.00; deposits held of 80.00 give 80.00.
